note: Demo library. Every demo built through this process is harvested to at least L1 within 2 working days (sc-harvest). sc-first-meeting and sc-demo-plan check here first. Packages and READMEs live in SharePoint Library/<id>/.

modules.name: Sell more of every project, stage by stage
modules.what: Site/project record linked to the builder; build-type template fills a stage-by-stage wish list; custom Build board (whole job, won/to win/lost, next to chase); custom Template builder; custom Sales overview home with 'identified in time'; stage bar; site diary.
pains: manage by project, not by account
coaching reps who take orders instead of hunting
manual_steps: SysDcmSettings row for the stage bar
home page set on the workplace
seed sites, wish items, Feed notes, accounts and reps (not in the package)
customer_specific: build types, stages, product groups, AUD values
rule_breaks: site data not in the package
modules.notes: Built before the build-for-reuse rules; promote to L2 on first reuse (split layers, seed script, remap prefix).

modules.name: The rep knows what to raise before every visit
modules.what: Field Sales home (my day), Outlet 360 custom page, visit briefing agent (AI Studio) ranked by a business-owned priorities table with confirm-then-save and a log, read aloud, licensed vs non-licensed visit steps on mobile, direct and partner orders, live priority change.
pains: information spread across SAP, data lake, image recognition
manual_steps: AI Studio agent re-created from PROJECT-NOTE (not exported); deploy to the stand's Studio environment
workplace SQL + cache reset; home page set live
customer_specific: Rsw prefix and 'Suntory Field Demo' captions
outlets, territory, reps, products, channels, A$
rule_breaks: design packages chosen by the platform
agent prompt not saved as a file
account tab depends on the Ord Minnett package
modules.notes: Built on a shared stand before the build-for-reuse rules. Best candidate for L2/L3 once a second field-sales deal appears (FMCG journey is also missing from the packs).

modules.name: Every enquiry gets an owner in a minute

no pipeline view by course and intake
manual_steps: switch off standard B2B lead rules
customer_specific: courses, intakes, lead sources, advisors, students

people data not in the package
